_about: Shot list for the jAIsus hero emotion clips. Every clip starts and ends on media-originals/base/jaisus-base-4k.png (hands around the glowing heart) so AnimatedJesus can switch clips seamlessly. Keyframed clips: a 4K styleframe (Nano Banana Pro, edit of the base frame) is the peak; MiniMax H3 2K renders base->peak and peak->base (4 s each), joined into one 8 s clip. Idle clips are a single 8 s H3 render with base as start and end frame. High-res originals live in media-originals/ (gitignored); public/emotions/*.mp4 are 1080p H.264 encodes.
styleframe_prefix: Edit the reference image. Keep EVERYTHING identical: the same man (same face, long brown hair, beard), the golden halo ring, the glowing orange Sacred Heart with the small crown of flames in front of his chest, the cream robe and golden sash, the night garden with white columns, trees and starry sky, the golden light rays, the exact framing, camera distance and painterly-photoreal style. Change ONLY:
video_prefix: Locked-off static camera, no zoom, no pan. Jesus with the golden halo and the glowing Sacred Heart in front of his chest.
video_suffix: Background, halo, light rays and garden stay still except soft twinkling stars and a gently pulsing heart glow. Smooth, natural, realistic motion. No text, no extra people.

clips.styleframe: his facial expression: he is laughing heartily with pure joy, eyes crinkled, wide genuine open-mouthed smile showing teeth, head tilted slightly back. Hands stay cradling the glowing heart.
